s: How many Delimitation Commissions have been constituted by the Government of India till December 2023?
x: Delimitation means the process of fixing the number of seats and boundaries of territorial constituencies in each State/UT for the Lok Sabha and Legislative assemblies. It also includes determining the seats to be reserved for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) in these Houses. The 'delimitation process' in India is performed by the 'Delimitation Commission' that is set up under an Act of Parliament. In India, such Delimitation Commissions have been constituted 4 timesin 1952 under the Delimitation Commission Act, 1952, in 1963 under the Delimitation Commission Act, 1962, in 1973 under the Delimitation Act, 1972 and in 2002 under the Delimitation Act, 2002. The delimitation of four north-eastern States by the Delimitation Commission of 2002 (Chairman-Justice Kuldip Singh) was deferred due to security risks, by four separate presidential orders, all issued on 8 February 2008, for Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland and Manipur.
